card.name: Inside intravenous before immunoglobulin or drug
card.fires_on: The ending of 'intravenous' after 'intr' (as in intravenous immunoglobulin or amiodarone), and sometimes the small word right before an immunosuppressive or intravenous therapy term, such as 'e.g.,' or 'with'.

modes.label: intravenous split
modes.description: The 'avenous' piece completing 'intravenous' in front of immunoglobulin, nutritional admixtures or a drug name.

modes.label: Linking word before therapy
modes.description: A comma, 'with' or a closing bracket just before a named treatment, often an intravenous or immunosuppressive one.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like 'secondary' and 'class', which suggests a classification-type term next.
card.plain: It lights up on the end of the word intravenous, mostly when immunoglobulin or an IV drug comes next.
